targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS SecurityToolEvents FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND (ingestion_path = '/security' OR startsWith(ingestion_protocol, 'syslog')) AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}')

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS NetworkEvents FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND (event_category IN ('network','dns','web','intrusion_detection') OR source_ip != '' OR destination_ip != '') AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}')

panels.title: Network activity

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, concat(vendor, ' / ', product) AS source, count() AS events FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND (ingestion_path = '/security' OR startsWith(ingestion_protocol, 'syslog')) AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time

SELECT vendor, count() AS events FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY vendor ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT product, count() AS events FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY product ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT source_type, count() AS events FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ingestion_protocol, count() AS events FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY ingestion_protocol ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT signature, count() AS alerts FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND signature != '' AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY signature ORDER BY alerts DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT source_ip, count() AS events FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND source_ip != '' AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY source_ip ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT destination_ip, count() AS events FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND destination_ip != '' AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY destination_ip ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT domain, count() AS queries FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_category = 'dns' AND domain != '' AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') GROUP BY domain ORDER BY queries DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT event_time AS Time, device_name AS Device, source_ip AS SourceIP, destination_ip AS DestinationIP, url AS URL FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_category = 'web' AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT event_time AS Time, device_name AS Device, severity AS Severity, signature_id AS SignatureID, signature AS Signature, source_ip AS SourceIP, source_port AS SourcePort, destination_ip AS DestinationIP, destination_port AS DestinationPort, outcome AS Outcome FROM fusion.sysmon_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_kind = 'alert' AND match(host_name, '${computer:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(source_type, '${source:regex}') AND match(ingestion_protocol, '${ingestion:regex}') ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200
